title_candidates: Your Chat Is Full — Here's What Claude Drops 🧊
tags: claude forgets,context window,claude ai,long chats,ai memory,chatgpt forgets,claude tips,ai for beginners,summary prompt,fresh chat,ai tools,claude tricks
carry: the glass tube never leaves frame; the hot magenta block (the thing you told it) crosses every phase: in, down, out, back

plant.what: the hot block arrives in the first 1.5s — the payoff's absence is its ejection

knee.what: the OVERFLOW — the tube mouth flashes and the first block is ejected out the open bottom

payoff.what: the ANSWER chip (FRI · 6 AM ✓) — the same scan that failed at 40% succeeds in the fresh tube

give.prompt: Summarize this whole chat as a short list of everything worth keeping — decisions, facts, numbers, names. Write it so I can paste it into a new chat and continue exactly where we left off.
give.where: description above the fold + pinned comment (give, don't promise)

lines.vo: You told Claude the important thing. Right here.
lines.subject: the hot block

lines.vo: But a chat only holds so much.
lines.subject: the tube
lines.to: FULL — mouth flashes, first block ejected out the bottom

lines.vo: Every new message pushes the oldest ones out.
lines.subject: the stack
lines.to: each arrival shoves it down; blocks fall into the dark, one by one

lines.vo: And one of them was yours.
lines.subject: the hot block
lines.to: ejected — resting dim in the dark below the glass

lines.vo: Ask again — nothing. It isn't broken. It just can't see down there.
lines.subject: the scan beam
lines.from: sweeping the tube top to bottom
lines.to: failed — a fog reply that dissolves; the hot block visible below, outside the glass

lines.vo: So before a long chat dies, ask for a summary of everything that matters.
lines.subject: the summary block
lines.from: sparks pulled out of every message
lines.to: one bright block, formed above the tube

lines.vo: Paste it into a fresh chat. Your line is back where Claude can see it.
lines.subject: the fresh tube
lines.from: sliding in as the full one exits
lines.to: summary block landed at its top slot, inside the glass

lines.vo: Ask again — instant answer. The exact prompt is in the description.
lines.subject: the scan beam
lines.to: HIT — the summary flares and the answer chip pops above the glass

scenes.note: cold-open plant: blocks mid-fall at frame 1, hot block lands
object-journey: overflow (KNEE), the loss, the failed scan
before/after: full tube vs fresh tube, the summary carried across
payoff: the mirrored scan hits; then the whiteout into the give card

outro.cta: The summary prompt is in the description. Steal it before your next long chat.
